name: labs/pcdshub__ophyd-ads
title: TwinCAT NC axis telemetry (ophyd-ads, read only)
intro: TwinCAT NC axis telemetry (ophyd-ads, read only), adapted from pcdshub/ophyd-ads. It reads `act_acc`, `act_pos`, `act_pos_modulo`, `act_torque` and 8 more. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/pcdshub__ophyd-ads --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/pcdshub__ophyd-ads --backend fake --mcp
